text: BIT MBA education started from 1994. The MBA Education Center belongs to School of Management and Economics, Beijing Institute of Technology, the Center specifically undertakes MBA project management of BIT under the guidance of the Graduate School. There are different departments within the MBA Education Center, which gives first-class student services to all students. The center consists of the department of marketing and admission, academic affairs, international exchange, career development, students affairs and alumni liaison. The MBA Education Center of Beijing Institute of Technology aims to lead an MBA program combined with outstanding education and business efficiency, as well as cultivate future leaders with dedicated and innovative capabilities. The MBA Education Center team has fully integrated resources from around the world. The program offers advanced management and leadership concepts and practices to enhance the quality of education as well as enhance the image of MBA.
